Salzgitter/Mercedes-Benz Bank AMG-Merced: Run by HWA AG from Affalterbach. HWA builds and runs the Mercedes DTM cars. Gary Paffett won the 2005 title.
Laureus AMG-Mercedes: The second HWA car pair. Car #7 is entered as AMG-Mercedes, car #8 as Laureus AMG-Mercedes.
Audi Sport Team Abt: One of the Abt Sportsline teams from Kempten. Timo Scheider won the 2008 and 2009 titles with the team.
Audi Sport Team Abt Sportsline: Hans-Jürgen Abt's team from Kempten. Has run Audis in the DTM since 2000. Mattias Ekström won the title in 2004 and 2007.
Audi Sport Team Phoenix: Founded by Ernst Moser. Based in Meuspath, next to the Nürburgring. Has run Audis in the DTM since 2006.
Audi Sport Rookie Team Abt: A one-car Abt Sportsline team for a rookie on a 2008 Audi A4. Miguel Molina drives.
TV Spielfilm/Junge Sterne AMG-Mercedes: Ingmar Persson's team. Runs three 2008 C-Klasse cars. Car #21 is entered as Stern AMG-Mercedes.
Audi Sport Team Rosberg: Keke Rosberg's team from Neustadt an der Weinstraße. First DTM season in 1995 with Opel. Has raced Audis since 2006.
Deutsche Post/GQ AMG-Mercedes: Peter Mücke's team from Berlin. Runs 2008 C-Klasse cars. David Coulthard drives his first DTM season here.
